title: MobsFilter
description: easily preventing specific vanilla or modded mobs from existing.
body:
![modlogo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/511c6a780401ca08cfc72de2d55cfcb877a238fa.png)

---
is a lightweight mod that lets you blacklist entities from spawning entirely. Keep your world/server clear of unwanted mobs with a fast, easy-to-use configuration and live in-game commands.

---

**Features**

*Entity Blacklisting*
* Total Control - Blacklist specific vanilla or modded entities from spawning entirely.
* Fast & Safe Cleanup - Entities are checked against a fast lookup table during spawn. Blacklisted entities are discarded immediately and cleaned up safely on the next server tick.
* Wide Compatibility - Works with standard vanilla namespaces (e.g., `minecraft:creeper`) and modded entities (e.g., `anothermod:some_entity`).

*Commands & Configuration (OP Required)*
* `/mobsfilter add <entity>` - Adds the entity to the blacklist and reloads it immediately. Supports clean autocomplete (with or without the `minecraft:` namespace).
* `/mobsfilter remove <entity>` - Removes the entity from the blacklist and reloads it instantly.
* `/mobsfilter list` - Shows all current blacklist entries loaded from the config.
* JSON Config - All changes are automatically saved and read from `config/mobsfilter-blacklist.json`.

*Config Example:*
```json
[
  "minecraft:creeper",
  "minecraft:enderman",
  "anothermod:some_entity"
]
```

**Dependencies:**
* Fabric API (required)

Server-Side - Works perfectly as a server-side mod. Your players do not need to download or install this mod on their clients for the entity filtering to work!
